# Derek Johnston

> Derek Johnston is a Lead Full Stack Developer based in Durham Region, Ontario, Canada, open to remote or local work. Derek also runs Johnston Software Development Inc. (https://johnstonsoftwaredevelopment.ca/), a web and mobile development company in Oshawa, Ontario.

I'm a Lead Full Stack Developer with over nine years of experience building web and mobile applications, from a near real-time data collection system at E-Data Now! to leading the frontend and backend teams behind YHP's Wonderlab event platform. In 2020 I founded Johnston Software Development Inc., where I design, build and modernize web and mobile apps for clients, most recently an ongoing platform modernization for a luxury watch subscription club. I work across the stack with Vue and Nuxt, React and Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript and Flutter, and I enjoy mentoring developers and leading teams.

Contact: Derek@Derekjohnston.ca. Resume (PDF): https://derekjohnston.ca/Derek-Johnston-Resume-Full.pdf

## Experience

- Founder & Lead Full Stack Developer, JSD (Oct 2023 - Present): I have been working on multiple high-impact projects, including revising and upgrading the tech stack for the 'Who's Jimmy' project, enhancing its functionality, and planning a new section for teaching videos to showcase James Gawley's expertise in the film industry. I collaborated with a team to improve the frontend UI/UX of a web application using ReactJS and Tailwind CSS, which resulted in improved user engagement metrics. I developed a mobile-first web app prototype with NextJS within a tight deadline, optimized responsive web designs using Bootstrap and CSS Grid, and upgraded a client's web app from Nuxt 2 to Nuxt 3, leveraging Vue 3 Composition API and TypeScript for enhanced SSR performance. Additionally, I developed tailored e-commerce platforms, mobile applications, and custom software solutions that effectively enhanced clients' online presence and operational efficiency.
- Lead Full Stack Developer, YHP (May 2021 - Sep 2023): In this role, I implemented agile methodologies to accelerate project delivery, mentored junior developers, and conducted thorough code reviews to ensure best practices were followed. I fostered a collaborative and innovative environment, leading to the development of robust and versatile projects that significantly added value to the company. I was responsible for comprehensive staff performance reviews, full-cycle recruitment, and facilitating smooth employee transitions. A key achievement was leading the development of Wonderlab, a white-labeled event platform that reduced setup costs for new live events and allowed for extensive client customization. Additionally, I directed cross-functional teams in creating a gamified HR onboarding system, a versatile event platform supporting both online and in-person events, and an administrative hub application offering real-time analytics and user management features.
- Freelance Full Stack Developer, JSD (Dec 2019 - May 2021): During this period, I created a Java Android application to replace an existing Cordova app for a shipping company, improving performance and reliability while seamlessly integrating with the existing backend. I developed a map component for the Tackle Hunger project, displaying food banks and their needs across North America. Additionally, I worked on the ongoing development of a professional portfolio for a skilled film craftsman and clock-smith using VueJS/NuxtJS and PHP. I also delivered tailored e-commerce websites, mobile apps, and custom software solutions, significantly enhancing clients' digital presence and operational capabilities.
- Software Developer, E-data Now! (Apr 2018 - Sep 2019): I developed frontend and backend code for a near real-time data collection system for inspection and auditing in the automotive industry. I maintained test plans, wrote automated and load tests, enhanced dashboard functionality, and optimized slow API calls using Scout APM. Additionally, I resolved issues in iOS and Flutter codebases, improving performance and UX. My exceptional performance during a field placement led to a full-time employment offer.
- Software Engineer, Oiika (May 2017 - Apr 2019): I collaborated closely with a small team to design and develop an online platform using modern web technologies such as TypeScript, Express.js, and React.js. I played a key role in implementing responsive and dynamic user interfaces with ReactNative and Tailwind CSS, enhancing the platform's overall user experience. I optimized backend functionality using Node.js and Express.js, ensuring efficient data handling and API performance. My contributions included developing a flexible and maintainable codebase by leveraging SASS and Git for version control, as well as actively participating in the testing and debugging process to improve the platform's stability.

## Skills

SASS, JavaScript, Git, TypeScript, Express.js, React.js, Node.js, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Tailwind CSS, PHP, Next.js, Docker Products, Redux.js, Flutter, iOS, Vue.js, Android, Nuxt.js, Java, Leadership

Tech: Bootstrap, Git/GitHub for version control, React.
- [Nuxt 2 to Nuxt 3 Upgrade Project](https://johnstonsoftwaredevelopment.ca/projects/11/): Upgraded client's web app from Nuxt 2 to Nuxt 3, leveraging Vue 3 Composition API, optimizing SSR performance, and integrating TypeScript. Tech: Nuxt2, Nuxt3, Vue2, Vue3.

This project showcases seamless user authentication with diverse third-party APIs, ensuring secure and flexible access for a wide range of users.
- [Java-Based Dating App Static Demo](https://johnstonsoftwaredevelopment.ca/projects/14/): Developed a static demo of a dating application using Java, featuring a user-friendly interface and showcasing key functionalities. Tech: Java, Git/GitHub for version control, Responsive Design Techniques.

- [Home maintenance](https://johnstonsoftwaredevelopment.ca/projects/16/): This project involved designing and developing a comprehensive mobile solution for homeowners and property managers to streamline residential upkeep. The application serves as a centralized hub for scheduling routine maintenance, tracking home improvement projects, and connecting with verified service professionals. Tech: Flutter, Firebase.

Built using a robust combination of Kotlin and Java, the app focuses on delivering real-time accuracy through a sleek, modern interface. Tech: Kotlin, JAVA, GeoMet-OGC-API.
- [Membership Platform Modernization](https://johnstonsoftwaredevelopment.ca/projects/18/) (June 2026 - Present): Ongoing engineering partnership with a luxury watch subscription club: modernizing their admin platform and building new member experiences, from event tooling to a weekly sports pick'em game. Tech: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, MySQL, PHP, Playwright, Vitest.

Learn about the intuitive interface and customizable tools that enhance user communication. Click to learn more! Tech: SQLite, Flutter.

Tech: NextJS, ReactJS, Mapbox, Material-UI, Algolia.
